lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A non-linear distribution of high-luminance circular clusters is observed on the lateral flank. Specifically, a cluster of prominent spots is arranged in a quasi-grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to a higher density of smaller, more randomly distributed spots toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, creating anchor nodes where they intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like matrix on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge transitioning to a sharp shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible in the ventral shadow region of the shark, aligned with the direction of travel.
